snippet.title: Sonic the Hedgehog (Mega Drive/Genesis) playthrough ~Longplay~
snippet.description:
This is a playthrough of Sonic the Hedgehog for the SEGA Mega Drive/Genesis.

Sonic 1 may be a bit on the slow side compared to later games, but it's still a good time in its own right. In this run I'll be collecting all 6 Chaos Emeralds from the special stages and getting the good ending... which really isn't that different from the bad ending.

---
